enabled.description: `auto` (default) renders the monitor objects when monitoring.coreos.com/v1 is served on the cluster (an offline `helm template` resolves to false unless the API is passed in); `true` / `false` force them on or off.

`auto` (default) renders the Kyverno objects when kyverno.io/v1 is served on the cluster (an offline `helm template` resolves to false unless the API is passed in); `true` / `false` force them on or off.

flavor.description: `auto` (default) selects `cilium` when cilium.io/v2 is served on the cluster and `kubernetes` otherwise; `cilium` / `kubernetes` force the flavor.
